title: Move the push-only 'main is fast-forward of dev' guard into its own unfiltered workflow and pin that it has no path filter
description: Binding record: opum-doc main 7818aca8b, docs/adr/keep-push-path-filters-off-main-guard-release-publish-and-federation-jobs.md (ODOC-287, commit 0e96eaf3f, opum-ai/opum-doc#459; opum-agent OPAG-444). Read it there before implementing. Defect: paths-ignore applies to the whole workflow, so a Markdown-only push to main (a non-fast-forward rewind included) skips ci.yml's 'main is fast-forward of dev' job. That job runs only on the push to main and main has no ruleset, so it is the one guard that cannot afford to be skipped. LCLI-602 (opum-ai/lore-cli#293) narrowed the filter (CLAUDE.md and README.md no longer ignored) but did not remove this hole. Ruling: a push path filter on main is cost control and is permitted, but it must never cover a job that runs only on that push. (1) Move the job into its own workflow file with NO paths/paths-ignore at all, keeping its rendered job name 'main is fast-forward of dev' exactly, so anything referencing it by name (and CLAUDE.md's promotion prose) stays true. (2) Pin with a test that this workflow carries no path filter and fires on push to main. (3) docs/** and skills/** STAY ignored on ci.yml's main push (the pull_request run already tested the identical tree on ubuntu and windows; macOS coverage of a Markdown-only change is deferred to the next code push, a deliberate OPAG-429 cost choice). Also audit release.yml and upstream-backlog-watch.yml, and any other workflow, for a push-only, release, publish or federation job sharing a filtered workflow; the ADR names the pattern fleet-wide. Update CLAUDE.md's repository profile, which says a docs-only push does not trigger the guard; that sentence becomes false. Proving it needs a real Markdown-only push to main, which the next docs-only promotion supplies (the same shape as LCLI-602 AC1).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The main is fast-forward of dev job lives in its own workflow with no paths or paths-ignore, keeping its exact rendered name and its LCLI-514 assertions (new tip on dev, old tip an ancestor), and ci.yml no longer carries it
test/ci-workflow.test.ts (or equivalent) pins that the guard workflow has no path filter and triggers on push to main; a mutation adding a paths-ignore turns it red
docs/** and skills/** remain in ci.yml push paths-ignore; every other workflow is audited for a push-only/release/publish/federation job behind a path filter, with the result recorded here
CLAUDE.md repository profile no longer claims a docs-only push skips the guard; bun test and bun run lore check exit 0
A real Markdown-only push to main runs the guard, proven by its run id (the next docs-only promotion)
